categories.main_business_segments: Hunan Kylinsec Technology Co., Ltd. primarily operates in three main business segments: operating systems, cloud computing, and information security. The company develops and sells high-security, high-reliability, and customizable domestic operating systems, cloud desktop and cloud platform products, and data security storage solutions. It also explores AI integration with its core products to provide intelligent computing solutions.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages open-source Linux technology to develop its proprietary operating systems, including server, desktop, and embedded versions. Key technologies include unified security strategy models, trusted measurement and chain transmission, integrated cryptographic frameworks supporting national cryptographic algorithms, cluster high-availability, and real-time virtualization. Cloud computing products utilize virtualization, distributed storage, and GPU virtualization technologies, while information security products focus on NAS and SAN secure storage, transparent encryption, and data integrity verification. The company employs agile and waterfall combined software development models and maintains a secure, automated supply chain for software and hardware integration.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Kylinsec serves critical infrastructure sectors with a focus on energy (especially electric power), government, finance, telecommunications, education, healthcare, and special industries requiring high information security. Its products are widely used in power grid dispatching, power generation, transmission, distribution, and storage systems, as well as in secure office environments and industrial control systems. The company has established strong relationships with large state-owned enterprises and key industry players.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily within China, with a strong presence in major regions including North China, East China, South China, Central China, Northwest, Southwest, and Northeast China. It has expanded its regional marketing and technical service networks by establishing subsidiaries and branches in cities such as Kunming, Shenyang, Guangzhou, Shanghai, and Jiangxi to enhance local market penetration and customer support.
categories.supply_chain_position: Kylinsec operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the IT supply chain, focusing on software development, integration, and provision of comprehensive solutions combining operating systems, cloud computing platforms, and information security products. It procures hardware components such as servers, storage devices, and thin clients, assembles and integrates them with proprietary software, and delivers complete solutions and services directly to end customers and system integrators.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation in domestic operating systems, cloud computing, and information security, with significant R&D investment (over 27% of revenue). It focuses on enhancing security, performance, AI integration, and industrial control capabilities. Key R&D projects include development of new OS versions, cloud desktop solutions, secure storage systems, AI computing platforms, and migration tools for transitioning from legacy systems like CentOS. The company actively participates in open-source communities and national standards development to foster ecosystem growth and technological leadership.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of proprietary software products, integrated hardware-software solutions, and technical services. The company employs a one-time licensing fee model for software products, supplemented by subscription-based models for cloud services available on platforms like Huawei Cloud and Alibaba Cloud. It also earns income from system maintenance, technical support, and customized solution delivery. Direct sales to end customers dominate, complemented by sales through agents and e-commerce platforms.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Kylinsec is one of the leading domestic providers of secure, high-reliability operating systems and related cloud and security products in China. It holds a strong position in the power and special industries sectors, with recognized certifications and endorsements from national security agencies. The company benefits from early mover advantages in the domestic server OS market and is a key participant in the openEuler ecosystem. Competitors include other domestic OS vendors and international Linux distributors, but Kylinsec differentiates itself through deep industry customization and integrated security solutions.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Kylinsec achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 286.4 million, representing a 75.24% year-over-year increase. The company returned to profitability with a net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 7.94 million, reversing previous losses. Total assets stood at about RMB 1.42 billion with net assets of RMB 1.24 billion. The company maintains a strong R&D investment ratio and has shown steady growth driven by expanding market demand and product innovation.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Kylinsec emphasizes its unique value proposition of providing secure, stable, and high-performance domestic operating systems tailored for critical infrastructure and special industries. Its 'three-in-one' integrated product strategy combining operating systems, cloud computing, and information security offers customers comprehensive, interoperable, and compliant solutions. The company’s products support multiple domestic CPU architectures, incorporate national cryptographic standards, and deliver AI-enhanced capabilities, ensuring high security and reliability. Its strong industry focus, extensive technical support network, and participation in open-source ecosystems further differentiate it from competitors.
